summary: Preserved candidate PR 1979's batching/session/prefetch fixes, reproduced review PR 2076's unbounded per-process retry counterexamples at exact candidate commit 611cdb905edbdba7ccb82fcbad2200e514c5eb8b, and added bounded exponential backoff plus terminal receiver failure after eight unresolved DP-rank queries.

tests.what_was_measured: The exact candidate's complete modified file passed 11 tests before correction.
The actual candidate gate allowed 100/100 attempts spaced 11 ms apart, had no retry cap state, and eight independent queues each allowed an initial attempt.
12 tests passed, including bounded terminal failure and independent-address boundaries.

gpu_evidence: One MI355X gfx950 was inventoried, but no GPU execution is claimed for the CPU-side HTTP scheduler correction.
remaining_limitations: Retry state remains process-local: DP8 can make eight initial attempts and at most 64 attempts across eight processes before terminal failure; safe once-per-node ownership is not implemented.
The two-node TP8/EP8/DP8 MoRI workload, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 weights, exact Errno 99 exhaustion, and successful distributed model serving were unavailable and remain unverified.
